title: Structured Unitary Tensor Network Representations for Circuit-Efficient Quantum Data Encoding
abstract: arXiv:2602.16266v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Encoding classical data into quantum states is a central bottleneck in quantum machine learning: many widely used encodings are circuit-inefficient, requiring deep circuits and substantial quantum resources, which limits scalability on quantum hardware. In this work, we propose tensor network-based quantum data encoding (TNQE), a circuit-efficient framework built on structured unitary tensor network (TN) representations. TNQE first represents each classical input via a TN decomposition and then compiles the resulting tensor cores into an encoding circuit through two complementary core-to-circuit strategies. To make this compilation trainable while respecting the unitary nature of quantum operations, we introduce a unitary-aware constraint that parameterizes TN cores as learnable block unitaries, enabling them to be directly optimized and directly encoded as quantum operators. The proposed TNQE framework enables explicit control

translated_title: 面向电路高效量子数据编码的结构化酉张量网络表示
translated_abstract: 将经典数据编码到量子态中是量子机器学习的一个核心瓶颈：许多广泛使用的编码方式电路效率低下，需要深层电路和大量量子资源，这限制了其在量子硬件上的可扩展性。在本工作中，我们提出了基于张量网络的量子数据编码（TNQE），这是一个建立在结构化酉张量网络（TN）表示之上的电路高效框架。TNQE首先通过张量网络分解来表示每个经典输入，然后通过两种互补的核心到电路策略将所得的张量核心编译为编码电路。为了使这一编译过程可训练，同时尊重量子操作的酉性质，我们引入了一种酉感知约束，将张量网络核心参数化为可学习的块酉矩阵，使其能够被直接优化并直接编码为量子算符。所提出的TNQE框架实现了显式控制……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于结构化酉张量网络表示的电路高效量子数据编码框架TNQE，通过将经典数据分解为张量核心并编译为编码电路，同时引入酉感知约束将核心参数化为可学习的块酉矩阵，从而降低量子机器学习中数据编码所需的电路深度与量子资源开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TNQE, a circuit-efficient quantum data encoding framework built on structured unitary tensor network representations, which decomposes classical inputs into tensor cores, compiles them into encoding circuits via two complementary strategies, and introduces a unitary-aware constraint parameterizing cores as learnable block unitaries to reduce circuit depth and quantum resource overhead.
